name: Amami Norisuke
source:
[url=/c95191]Souma[/url]'s father.

He holds a high position within his company. However, he pays no heed to his family, only handing over the absolute minimum to his [url=/c95414]wife[/url] every month, spending the rest on other women in hostess bars and such. Because of this, the marriage is in shambles. He refuses to file for divorce due to the shame it brings.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
